calculation.description: Multiply 20-observation momentum by 10-observation return efficiency, then remove the contemporaneous cross-sectional linear exposure to 5-observation returns. Higher values indicate efficient medium-term momentum not explained by short-term trend. All inputs use each asset's native timestamp and only information available at decision time.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive across 2020-2022 (+0.040557), 2023-2024 (+0.029594), and 2025-2027 (+0.028193). Cross-section is the 15-asset benchmark universe; average daily N=14.13, so uncertainty is interpreted conservatively.
